Plugin.Name: Backblaze64 Monitor
Plugin.Overview: Dashboard tile for Backblaze64, backed by its key-authenticated API -- live speed, backup progress, and more, right on your Unraid Dashboard.
Plugin.Description:
Adds a native Unraid Dashboard tile for the Backblaze64 container (Backblaze Personal Backup running under Wine), backed by its key-authenticated /api/v1/status endpoint. Shows upload speed, backup progress, file counts, failures, memory usage, and connection latency without needing to open a separate browser tab.
Auto-refreshing, collapsible to a one-line summary, with color-coded progress bars. A dedicated settings page lets you choose which fields appear and how they're arranged across the tile's two columns.
Requires a running Backblaze64 container reachable from the server, and an API key generated from its own Web UI (API tab, Read permission).
